Plot method for vilma.beta objects

Source: R/plot.vilma.beta.R
plot.vilma.beta.Rd

Produces quick-look maps of mean PhyloSor similarity and mean PhyloSor dissimilarity per cell from a vilma.beta object (output of phylosor.calc). Values are drawn using the underlying terra raster and annotated with the cell-wise means.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'vilma.beta'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class vilma.beta, typically returned by phylosor.calc and containing the rasters $rasters$mean.similarity and $rasters$mean.dissimilarity.

...

Additional graphical arguments (currently ignored).

Value

Invisibly returns x (the input object), allowing further use in pipelines.

Details

The function opens a 2-panel plotting layout (par(mfrow=c(2,1))) and renders:

  1. Mean PhyloSor similarity per cell ($rasters$mean.similarity).

  2. Mean PhyloSor dissimilarity per cell ($rasters$mean.dissimilarity).

For each panel, numeric values are overlaid at cell centroids (rounded to 2 decimals). The plotting is performed with terra (i.e., terra::plot).

Expect NA cells when communities were filtered (e.g., method = "exclude") or when no value could be computed. The function temporarily modifies graphical parameters and restores them on exit.

See also

phylosor.calc, print.vilma.beta, faith.pd
